title: Databases without backup history
description: Return databases for which the backups table contains no rows of any status. Return exactly one column: database_name. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.name AS database_name
FROM databases AS d
hints: LEFT JOIN preserves a database without a match.
Check NULL on the backups row key rather than status.
solution_explanation: An anti-join using LEFT JOIN + IS NULL finds complete absence of history.
